next.reason: 1985: the END PROGRAM program-name 'must conform to the rules for forming a user-defined word.' 2023 §2023:10.7.2 writes the operand as program-name-1, which by §2023:5.2.4 is one of 'the types listed in 8.3.2.2' (§2023:8.3.2.2 lists program-name among the user-defined words), and §2023:10.7.3 SR2 requires it to be 'identical to the program-name declared in a preceding PROGRAM-ID paragraph'. The requirement is unchanged; changes to the word-formation rules themselves belong to the 1985 word-formation rule's own record.
